newsitem.title: USA: Newport News Shipbuilding to sell shares.
newsitem.headline: Newport News Shipbuilding to sell shares.

text.p: Newport News Shipbuilding Inc said on Tuesday it was offering shareholders who owned fewer than 100 of its common shares as of January 7 to buy additional ones to reach a position of exactly 100 shares.
The company said the voluntary program it was implementing also offered those same shareholders the option to sell what they held.
It said many of its shareholders had received fewer than 100 shares of stock when it was spun off from Tenneco Inc in December.
Shareholders got one share of Newport stock for every five shares of Tenneco stock, it said.
